summary: Frontend-only smoke + flow tests for the new Prayer expansion (Divine Mercy Chaplet + Devotions & Prayers library on /prayer). All 7 acceptance items pass: prayer hub renders with all 6 category section headers (Marian, Litanies, Stations, Mass & Communion, Devotions & Acts, Seasonal & Feast Day); Divine Mercy Chaplet card opens as a tap-through and Next/Prev advance correctly; 4 reader-format devotions (angelus, litany_loreto, memorare, st_michael_prayer) each render prayer-reader-block-0 + prayer-good-work, and 'Amen — Done' returns to hub while 'Journal this' correctly navigates to /journal with seeded title/body; all 3 Stations variants (stations_traditional, stations_scriptural, way_of_cross_liguori) open in steps mode with prayer-step visible and Next advancing; no 'Prayer not found' on any tested route; existing prayer cards (rosary, novenas, consecration, companions, all chaplets) still render with no regression; language switch to ES and IT loads the hub and a reader prayer (Angelus / Litany of Loreto) without crashing. No backend changes — backend not tested per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/frontend/app/prayer/[kind].tsx line ~293 uses Spanish-only fallback ('completado hoy' / 'Reflexión') in the steps-mode Journal seed_body — Italian users will see Spanish here when completing a chaplet/stations. The reader-mode equivalent (line ~179) correctly branches en/es/it. Not a blocker but worth aligning for full IT parity.

Pre-existing console warnings (not introduced by this feature): 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and '[expo-notifications] push-token listener not supported on web.' Worth noting for tech debt.
seed_data_creation: None — all prayer content is local TS data, no API calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prayer hub at /prayer is fully working as of iter 71. Use session token test_feat_aug25 via localStorage. Reader devotion runner uses testIDs: prayer-runner-screen, prayer-reader-block-{i}, prayer-good-work, prayer-journal, prayer-done, prayer-close. Steps runner uses prayer-step, prayer-next, prayer-prev. Section headers use devotion-section-{marian|litany|stations|mass|devotional|seasonal}. Routes resolve in order rosary → CHAPLETS → DEVOTIONS in /app/frontend/app/prayer/[kind].tsx.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the new feature.
